Can Marissa draft the quota bump spreadsheet? Karthik — can you confirm Dedicated provisioning lead time and a sample config? Ben — any special routing or fallback we should enable for the session (model variant fallback, cheaper quantized path)?

Thanks Vanessa —

Great checklist. A few quick answers: 
- We'd prefer Hosted for speed of setup but would consider Dedicated if the token burns look high during load tests. For the kickoff itself, Hosted is fine.
- Prompt mix: roughly 70% short chat (<=120 tokens), 30% long summarization (avg 1,800–2,200 tokens).
- For the load test, our engineering lead suggests starting with 80 concurrent users aiming for ~160 rps with short prompts and ~30 rps with long prompts (end-to-end tokens/sec ~= 40k tokens/sec peak). Latency SLO: p95 < 750ms for short prompts, p95 < 2s for long.

We can do the hands-on workshop on Mon, Nov 7 10:00–12:00 PT if that works for your team. If not, Tue Nov 8 also ok.

I'll share a short internal doc with our top 12 sample prompts by end of today.

—Emma

Thanks for the ping. Quick answers from infra/ops: 

- Dedicated provisioning: we can spin up a minimal Dedicated pool (4x A100-ish equivalents) in ~48 hours if approvals are in place; for a conservative POC config I'd recommend 4 GPUs, 16 vCPU control plane, 256GB RAM. That will handle the proposed peak for 2–3 model variants with warm KV caches.
- Hosted quota bump: for the '80 concurrent / 160 rps short' profile I recommend a temporary quota bump to 300 rps and a token budget of ~1.2M tokens for the 2-hour test window (we can break that down by short vs long).
- Load-test options: propose three tiers — Smoke (40 concurrent / 80 rps short), Standard (80 concurrent / 160 rps short, 40k tokens/sec peak), Spike (150 concurrent / 300 rps short). We'll provide a script that increments ramp and validates p95.

Ben: regarding graceful degradation, I recommend enabling a model-variant fallback to the quantized base model and prefix caching for the long prompts. Also, set per-user rate limits to avoid noisy neighbors during the hands-on.

I'll attach a short provisioning checklist and a sample Dedicated config.

—Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
